title: ACC / BIM 360 Deliverable Exchange Standard

requirements.statement: Project information exchanges shall use the governed CDE and the applicable ISO 19650 information-delivery process, with ACC folders, reviews and transmittals serving as implementation mechanisms appropriate to the declared exchange purpose.
Ad-hoc sharing links or email attachments shall not be used where the applicable project information-management arrangements require governed CDE traceability.

For information governed by the ISO 19650-2 delivery sequence, ACC implementation shall preserve the sequence of task-team submission, lead-appointed-party review and authorization, lead-appointed-party submission, and appointing-party review and acceptance before the applicable Shared-to-Published transition is completed.
Deliverable information shall comply with the governed project naming, metadata, status and applicable exchange prerequisites before the relevant submission or state transition.

TIVERIT coordination sign-off, ACC issue closure, review completion, platform permission, folder placement, transmittal creation or technical publication action shall not replace the ISO 19650 review, approval-for-sharing, authorization or acceptance activity required for the applicable CDE transition.

ACC evidence for a Decision B transition shall identify or reference the applicable information-model authorization and acceptance records and the responsible ISO 19650 parties or project-mapped functions. Where authorization and acceptance are separate activities, both shall remain independently traceable.

Project status or issue labels such as For Review / Comment, For Construction or As Built shall be interpreted through the governed project status and permitted-use rules and shall not replace the ISO 19650 CDE state or required transition evidence.

acc_implementation_mapping.iso_semantic: state reached after applicable review and approval for sharing; ACC mapping shall preserve Decision A evidence
state reached after applicable Decision B authorization and acceptance process; ACC mapping shall preserve both activities where separated
platform/project review context only; not a replacement ISO CDE state
project-defined status/permitted-use code; not a replacement for Decision B evidence
project-defined record/handover context; not by itself a supplementary handover-acceptance decision

implementation_boundary: ACC/BIM 360 implements governed exchange and preserves evidence. It shall preserve rather than redefine the ISO 19650 CDE transition and information-model delivery semantics.

provenance.migration_note: ISO-IMP-005 re-audit replaces the generic TIVERIT formal-exchange decision abstraction with the applicable ISO 19650-2 information-model delivery sequence for ISO-governed exchanges, while retaining ACC as the implementation and evidence layer.
